clips.send: Brâncuși fits two embracing people into a single block-like form. The first stone version is in the Craiova Art Museum, Romania. The Library of Congress holds this photo. The location of the plaster shown here is unconfirmed. Find the lines that divide the block into two people and follow the arms that join them.

clips.send: The raised shape is part of the slab. Look from the side to see its depth, then turn all the way to see how the slab hides it from behind.
clips.text: The raised shape is part of the slab. Look from the side to see its depth, then turn all the way to see how the slab hides it from behind.

clips.send: Look inside the opening, then at the pedestal. The dark part of the form facing away from the light is in form shadow. A cast shadow falls where the sculpture blocks light from reaching another surface.

clips.send: Rodin pulls the figure into a compact pose. Follow the elbow to the opposite knee. How does the twist affect the feeling of stillness? Follow the arm up to the chin and note how close the limbs are to the torso.

clips.send: Pour a liquid material through the opening. It fills the hollow from the bottom up.

clips.send: This seated Buddha was carved into the rock at Yungang. Narrow features around the eyes and mouth sit within wide, calm surfaces. Look for the broad planes of the cheeks and the thin shadow under the lower lip.

clips.send: The kneeling archers belong to the army made for the First Qin Emperor’s tomb. Follow a row of armor plates and see where it bends with the body. Compare the outline of the bent legs in the two photos.

clips.send: Michelangelo’s figure rests most of its weight on its own right leg. Look for changes in the shoulder and hip lines from the front to the back. Compare the straighter supporting leg with the relaxed, bent leg.
clips.text: Michelangelo’s figure rests most of its weight on its own right leg. Look for changes in the shoulder and hip lines from the front to the back. Compare the straighter supporting leg with the relaxed, bent leg.

clips.send: A flying bird supports one hoof. Follow the gaps between the horse’s other legs to see how the pose suggests speed. Follow the airborne legs down to the one hoof resting on a bird.

clips.send: Edo artisans made this head for a royal memorial altar in the Kingdom of Benin, in what is now Nigeria. It belongs to a group of works often called the Benin Bronzes. Compare the repeated beads with the broad, quiet planes of the face.
clips.text: Edo artisans made this head for a royal memorial altar in the Kingdom of Benin, in what is now Nigeria. It belongs to a group of works often called the Benin Bronzes. Compare the repeated beads with the broad, quiet planes of the face.

clips.send: Can a stone face seem to change expression when you move? Walk around a form, move the light, and see how something still can feel calm, powerful, or ready to move.
clips.text: Can a stone face seem to change expression when you move? Walk around a form, move the light, and see how something still can feel calm, powerful, or ready to move.

clips.send: Start with a solid block of stone. The rounded form is still inside it.
clips.text: Start with a solid block of stone. The rounded form is still inside it.

clips.send: A turn through the torso and a forward knee give this standing figure movement. The 3D view is a scan of a museum plaster cast of the marble. Compare the bare torso with the folds twisting below it.

clips.send: This form has a back you can see. Turn it and watch its outline narrow and widen.

clips.send: Proportion is how the sizes of parts relate. As you change the stance, the head stays the same size. In contrapposto, most weight rests on one leg while the other relaxes. The hips and shoulders often tilt in opposite directions.

clips.send: 这尊坐佛雕凿于云冈的岩壁中。眼睛和嘴唇刻画细致，周围的面部却宽阔平缓。找一找宽阔的脸颊和下唇底下细细的阴影。

clips.send: 跪射俑属于为秦始皇陵制作的陶俑军阵。沿着一排甲片看，找出它随身体转折的地方。找到抬起的膝盖，再沿着重复排列的甲片看。

clips.send: 米开朗琪罗笔下的大卫主要靠自身的右腿支撑。比较正背两面，留意肩线和髋线的变化。比较较直的支撑腿和放松弯曲的另一条腿。

clips.send: 凸起的形体与底板相连。转到侧面看凸起的厚度，再转到背面，看它怎样被底板遮住。

clips.send: 布朗库西把相拥的两个人概括成一个近似方块的形体。最早的石雕版本藏于罗马尼亚克拉约瓦艺术博物馆。这张照片藏于美国国会图书馆，照片中石膏像的现藏地点尚未确定。找出区分两个人物的线条，再沿着相拥的手臂看。

clips.send: 一只马蹄踏在飞鸟上。看看其他马腿之间的空隙，体会这个姿态怎样表现速度。顺着腾空的马腿往下看，找出唯一踏在飞鸟上的马蹄。
